findings.evidenceJa: 槍玉にあげられかねない
findings.governingReading: I might be singled out and made the target of the whole class
findings.explanation: The social image of being publicly put on the spot is reduced to vague abuse.

findings.highlight: I’ll hide myself in this classroom
findings.evidenceJa: 教室から一歩も出ないで篭城しよう
findings.governingReading: I will hole up under siege without taking a single step outside the classroom
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-military plan loses its no-exit condition and siege metaphor.
A report of Rin’s unpredictability becomes a judgment of madness.

findings.highlight: if he would stand on the edge of the roof for an entire day with her
findings.evidenceJa: 屋上の端で立ったまま一日付き合ってくれたら付き合ってもいい
findings.governingReading: if he would keep her company standing at the roof’s edge for a full day, she might date him
findings.explanation: The pun between accompanying Rin and dating her is only partly represented, obscuring her proposed experiment.

findings.highlight: the theory of falling in love on a bridge
findings.evidenceJa: つり橋の上の恋愛理論
findings.explanation: The named psychological trope loses the dangerous suspension-bridge condition.

findings.evidenceJa: 下々の人間には考え至らぬオツムでござる
findings.governingReading: a brain whose thoughts are beyond us common folk
findings.explanation: Gotou’s mock-feudal sarcasm about Rin’s bizarre reasoning becomes sincere praise.
A visible atmosphere of killing intent becomes a prediction of immediate killing.

findings.highlight: Was there a banana peel under your chair!?
findings.evidenceJa: 椅子にモーターでも仕込んだか
findings.governingReading: Did you put a motor in your chair?
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant replaces the original motor joke with an unsupported banana peel.

findings.highlight: did something like a flip. It seemed like you did a flip
findings.evidenceJa: にゃんと一回転。衛宮が椅子に座ったまま、一人で側転した
findings.governingReading: one full revolution—as though you did a cartwheel alone while seated
findings.explanation: The precise absurd image of a single seated cartwheel becomes generic flipping.
Shirou’s literary nickname for Rin’s impossible eraser throw becomes generic shooter.
The English adds screaming and loses the act of angrily challenging Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: 元気がないように見える
findings.explanation: Rin’s subdued emotional energy is broadened toward illness or general condition.
